status: confirmatory matrix complete; direct observation-only scope identifiability rejected
title: R6B paper-normalized public parity-scope identifiability

program_alignment.central_question: Can the physically public D4 record support an exact truth-free scalable likelihood graph?
program_alignment.scientific_layer: WP2/WP3 observation interface and scalable decoding gate
program_alignment.upstream_dependency: R6A primitive-size-2 exact factor ledger and corrected topology boundary
program_alignment.downstream_consumer: choice of direct public charge scopes versus richer edge/connectivity auxiliaries

question.research_question: On paper-normalized L=2, does a public flux plus measured-charge-support record uniquely determine the direct charge-parity scope signature across every compatible nonwinding edge assignment?
question.smallest_claim: The matrix may reject or retain direct observation-only scope identifiability on the registered finite paper geometry; it cannot reject richer fixed graphs involving latent edge/connectivity variables.

hypotheses.H_unique: Every tested public record has exactly one nonwinding parity-scope signature.
hypotheses.H_ambiguous: At least one fully enumerated public record has two or more nonwinding parity-scope signatures.

question.falsification_rule: One uncensored record with two exact compatible nonwinding signatures rejects H_unique.
question.censoring_rule: Any record reaching the compatible-assignment cap is reported censored and cannot support uniqueness.

research_basis.post_data_change_log: An exploratory development probe using seed 20260829 found candidate ambiguous records. Those records are not confirmatory evidence. This manifest freezes fresh seed 20260830 and the matrix below before the reported run.

model.public_record_for_scope: binary flux at every vertex plus the indicator that a charge outcome is measured (degree exactly two); charge bit values do not alter scopes
model.compatible_degree_sets: measured -> degree 2; unmeasured even flux -> degree 0; unmeasured odd flux -> degree 1 or 3
model.exact_scope: generate_loop_constraints on each compatible nonwinding assignment; winding assignments are separately counted terminal and do not receive ordinary O2 likelihood

matrix.positive_controls: all 12 geometry-derived isolated length-six trivial loops

analysis.primary: count fully enumerated records by number of distinct nonwinding parity-scope signatures
analysis.decision: reject direct observation-only scope identifiability if any uncensored record has more than one signature; otherwise retain without claiming proof beyond the matrix

budget.stop: no BP, correction, LER, threshold, or performance sampling

acceptance_items.evidence: results/r6b-paper-scope-identifiability-audit.json; 1000/1000 records fully enumerated, zero censored, 9 ambiguous, 12/12 isolated-hex controls pass
results/r6b-paper-scope-identifiability-audit.md; direct observation-only charge scopes rejected, latent edge/connectivity factor graphs remain open; 1/1 focused and 138/138 full-Lab tests pass
